summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run or committed. A line-length check (120 max) on the three Python files found no overlong lines; black and flake8 were not run. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data key raises ValueError; a directory given as the datalist path raises ValueError; malformed JSON propagates as JSONDecodeError (a ValueError subclass); items are shallow copies, so inputs are not mutated.
